text: 1. This triple falls is formed, either by the dirediorgan combination of the folutions of nitrate of ammonia, and nitrate of magnella, by which the falls is obtained pure and crytallized , or, by partially decomposing the nitrate of ammonia by matguela, or the nitrate of magenia by ammonia.

parsed.faithful: 1. This triple falt is formed, either by the direct combination of the solutions of nitrate of ammonia, and nitrate of magnesia, by which the falt is obtained pure and cryftallized ; or, by partially decomposing the nitrate of ammonia by magnesia, or the nitrate of magnesia by ammonia.
parsed.modern: 1. This triple salt is formed, either by the direct combination of the solutions of nitrate of ammonia, and nitrate of magnesia, by which the salt is obtained pure and crystallized; or, by partially decomposing the nitrate of ammonia by magnesia, or the nitrate of magnesia by ammonia.
